thread:
sara: @ops-oncall paging: scheduled heartbeat alert - hosted runtime KV cache OOM on gpunode-prod-7. High p99 latency for /v1/generate.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421. Severity: P1. Pager duty escalation sent to ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: I'm on it, grabbing logs. Which customers are hitting it?
mike: Seeing spike from customer 'PaperTrail' with very long prompt (~200k tokens) + continuous-batch enabled. KV cache per-request growth looks uncontrolled.
devon: Confirmed. KV cache size per session grew to 48GB on node gpunode-prod-7 and triggered OOM. Evictions didn't kick fast enough due to recent batching change.
jen: Is this related to the batching rollout from last night? We flipped continuous-batch v2 config on hosted runtime.
sara: yes, v2 changed how prefix caching interacts with batching window. It was supposed to be a noop but apparently double-counts prefixes when streaming or partial replies.
ops-oncall: I'm rolling a quick mitigation: reduce continuous-batch.window_ms from 80 -> 10 for hosted runtime pools to limit accumulation. Patching now.
mike: +1 do we need a feature-flag rollback?
devon: Rolling window tweak should be less disruptive than full rollback; quicker to push.
incident-bot: Deploy pipeline: patch-continuous-batch-window started by ops-oncall. CI checks passing.
ops-oncall: Patch applied to pool us-east-1-hosted-1. Observability shows KV cache growth rate dropping within 60s.
jen: Customers who saw errors: PaperTrail (errors 503), internal test tenants. Any SLO breaches?
sara: Early metrics: 5-minute p99 latency for generate dropped from 2.4s -> 0.9s after patch. Error rate for affected routes fell to baseline in ~3m.
devon: Node gpunode-prod-7 recovered after OOM kill and restart; it's back to serving.
mike: I'll open a hotfix PR to add a guard: max_kv_per_session=24GB and a telemetry alert if >70% of that.
ops-oncall: Creating customer impact summary for CS. Short blurb: "Transient 5-10m errors for customers with very long prompts when continuous-batch v2 was enabled; mitigated by reducing batching window and restarting affected nodes."
jen: Do we need to notify PaperTrail directly? CS wants template.
sara: Yes. Draft: "We experienced a transient interruption for requests with very long context windows caused by an interaction between a recent batching change and KV cache growth. We've applied a temporary configuration change to limit batching window and deployed additional guardrails. No customer data exposure. We're working on a root cause fix and a postmortem."
ops-oncall: Sent to CS channel and pinged PaperTrail account manager.
mike: Follow-up actions: 1) revert continuous-batch v2 default until further validation, 2) add max_kv_per_session config + alert, 3) add unit test for prefix double-counting, 4) run customer prompt sweep to find worst-case sequences.
devon: I'll take 2 and 3. Sara will lead 1.
sara: I'll coordinate rollback plan. Need sign-off from Eng infra and Product before rolling back default for all tenants.
jen: Can we deploy per-tenant feature-flag toggle to flip PaperTrail back to v1 only while we validate?
ops-oncall: Yes, starting per-tenant toggle patch for PaperTrail and a few others with heavy traffic.
incident-bot: INC-2026-0421 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring, CS notified, owners assigned.
mike: After-action note: we should add an integration test that simulates long streaming prompts with continuous-batch on to detect cache blowups early.
devon: Also log KV cache growth per-request id so we can backtrace offending sessions easily.
jen: Any follow-on on-call? ops-oncall handing to devops-night for overnight watch.
ops-oncall: Handoff to devops-night at 22:15 UTC. Leaving monitoring links and playbook steps in the incident doc.
devops-night: Acknowledged, monitoring alerts subscribed. Will escalate if >2 nodes hit >80% memory.
sara: Marking thread for postmortem. Assigning owners: sara (lead), devon (root cause), mike (mitigations), jen (customer comms).
ops-oncall: Closing paging loop for now. If you see regressions, reopen.
jen: tl;dr: Short outage for long-context requests due to KV cache growth after continuous-batch v2 flip. Fixed by reducing batch window and per-tenant toggles. Postmortem + guardrails planned. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident closed: INC-2026-0421 (status: mitigated).
